title: Nicole Kidman Reached Her Limits Filming Intense Scenes in 'Babygirl'
htmlContent:
Nicole Kidman's dedication to her roles is well-known, but her latest film Babygirl brought her to new levels of intensity on set. In a recent interview with The Sun, Kidman, 57, admitted that she became "burnt out" from filming the intimate scenes in the R-rated movie, which required her to push emotional and physical boundaries.
“There were times when we were shooting where I was like, ‘I don’t want to orgasm anymore,’” Kidman confessed. She humorously added, “[Like] don’t come near me. I hate doing this. I don’t care if I am never touched again in my life!”
Kidman portrays a high-powered CEO who embarks on a passionate relationship with a younger man, who is played by Harrison Dickinson, 28, years old. Antonio Banderas, a veteran actor, 64, completes the cast as her on-screen husband, increasing the level of complexity in the character's entanglements. According to the Oscar-winning actress, the intense scenes made her need multiple breaks during filming.
“I was so present all the time, but eventually, I just got over it,” Kidman shared,showing the emotional impact of the role.
50 Cent revealed the details of how his collaboration with Jay-Z came to fruition. He recalled that while Jay was instrumental in arranging certain parts of the verse, Diddy had his own unique ideas that he wanted to include.
